memory_candidates.content: A fully axiomatized finite ZTime task frame costs one call: FrameOver.ofStep (IntNormalForm.lean) discharges comp/serial/limit/saturation from a bi-serial one-step relation on a finite nonempty carrier. Declare the frame as an abbrev (a def leaves F.WorldState unreduced and every downstream statement fails), give a hand Fintype instance (no deriving handler), and build histories with worldHistoryOfStepPath from an IsStepPath proof.

TruthAntiIso carries only atom-level agreement and cannot transport a stab-like clause (needs state-level compatibility); L+ time_reflection soundness instead carries phi and phi.reflectTime together. A semantic time reversal FrameOver.rev (PosRel w x u := PosRel u x w) with all four axiom fields, rev rev = id by rfl, and AgreeUpTo <-> AgreeFrom under reversal compiles in ~80 lines and matches the manuscript's lem:time-reflection.
